name: Christopher Barrie
title: Assistant Professor of Sociology
tagline: Computational social science, language models, and political contention.
bio: I am a computational sociologist at New York University. My substantive work is on protest, conflict, communication, and political attitudes.
Methodologically, I work on natural language processing, large language models, and repurposing digital trace data for social science research.

affiliations.org: Department of Sociology, New York University
